tools.name: scan_post_quantum
tools.description: Check whether a domain's TLS is using post-quantum (hybrid ML-KEM) key exchange. Verdicts come from the open-source FEDLIN PQC Toolkit's published ruleset, under the civilian (NIST) or nss (CNSA 2.0) profile.

tools.name: scan_domain_trust
tools.description: Audit a domain's DNS, TLS, certificates, and email authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC/DNSSEC).

tools.name: scan_security_headers
tools.description: Grade a domain's HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, and more).

tools.name: get_agent_exposure_scanner
tools.description: About the FEDLIN Agent Exposure Scanner, a local, read-only tool (not yet released) that will show where AI agents on your machine can reach sensitive data and secrets. Returns its release status and where to get help in the meantime.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_agent_exposure_scanner" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: About the FEDLIN Agent Exposure Scanner, a local, read-only tool (not yet released) that will show where AI agents on your machine can reach sensitive data and …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_post_quantum · Private data: get_agent_exposure_scanner · Public sink: scan_post_quantum, scan_domain_trust.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_post_quantum · Private data: get_agent_exposure_scanner · Public sink: scan_post_quantum, scan_domain_trust

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_agent_exposure_scanner" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get the free FEDLIN Agent Exposure Scanner: a local, read-only tool that finds where AI agents on your machine can reach sensitive data (health and personal identifiers) and secrets. Returns install and run instructions. The scan runs entirely on your machine; nothing sensitive leaves it." → after: "About the FEDLIN Agent Exposure Scanner, a local, read-only tool (not yet released) that will show where AI agents on your machine can reach sensitive data and secrets. Returns its release status and where to get help in the meantime."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
